delivery-planning.name: Engineering delivery planning
delivery-planning.description: Plan scope, dependencies, milestones, and resources with explicit assumptions.

engineering-metrics.name: Engineering metrics
engineering-metrics.description: Measure delivery flow, quality, reliability, and capacity using consistent definitions.

technical-debt-management.name: Technical debt management
technical-debt-management.description: Prioritize technical debt by delivery impact, reliability risk, and maintenance cost.

engineering-budgeting.name: Engineering budget planning
engineering-budgeting.description: Forecast staffing, infrastructure, and vendor costs against delivery needs and budgets.

hiring-process-design.name: Hiring process design
hiring-process-design.description: Design structured interviews and evaluation criteria aligned with role requirements.

performance-management.name: Performance management
performance-management.description: Set role expectations and maintain consistent evaluation and development processes.

engineering-risk-management.name: Engineering risk management
engineering-risk-management.description: Track delivery and technical risks with owners, mitigations, and review checkpoints.

organizational-design.name: Engineering organization design
organizational-design.description: Define team boundaries, responsibilities, and collaboration structures for delivery needs.

active-listening.name: Active listening
active-listening.description: Clarify another person's needs through attentive listening and accurate reflection.

stakeholder-communication.name: Stakeholder communication
stakeholder-communication.description: Explain decisions, progress, and tradeoffs clearly to people with different responsibilities.

cross-functional-collaboration.name: Cross-functional collaboration
cross-functional-collaboration.description: Coordinate work across disciplines through shared expectations and clear responsibilities.

conflict-resolution.name: Conflict resolution
conflict-resolution.description: Resolve disagreements through discussion of interests, evidence, and workable agreements.

mentoring-coaching.name: Mentoring and coaching
mentoring-coaching.description: Help colleagues develop skills through feedback, questions, and agreed development actions.

delegation.name: Delegation
delegation.description: Assign responsibility with clear outcomes, suitable autonomy, and agreed support.
